rationale: The short position has captured over 70% of its intended move to the $10.00 psychological level, currently trading at $10.07 after setting a session low of $10.05. At current levels, holding exposes $0.28 per share of risk back to the $10.35 invalidation level in exchange for just $0.07 of remaining upside to the take-profit target. Closing now locks in the $141.39 gain and avoids the asymmetric risk of a front-run bounce just ahead of major whole-dollar support.
